summary: Frontend regression smoke test for the services/api.js refactor (1345-line monolith split into per-domain modules under services/api/*, with api.js now a thin barrel). All 7 required flows passed cleanly with ZERO console errors and ZERO uncaught/module-resolution errors. Tested on mobile viewport (430x900) using famtester@demo.sb.
critical_code_review_comments: Barrel /app/frontend/src/services/api.js (15 lines) cleanly re-exports from ./api/account, ./api/mobility, ./api/commerce, ./api/market, ./api/tracking, ./api/events, ./api/travel, ./api/health, ./api/content, ./api/admin, plus { api } and default from ./api/client.

Verified the consumer-facing API names live in the expected domains: authAPI (account.js), marketplaceAPI/favoritesAPI/walletAPI (commerce.js), realEstateAPI (market.js). All imports via the barrel still resolve.
Domain modules total 1383 lines (vs former monolith 1345) - small overhead from per-file imports/exports, acceptable. Each domain file is under 300 lines, well within the 700-line guideline.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test listings (Maison TEST Créée 250 000 €, Canapé cuir, Appartement T3 lumineux, etc.) and existing inbox conversations (Jean, Paul Vendeur, Jean Test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor regression fully validated. Login flow: /login -> 'Continuer avec l'e-mail' -> data-testid='email-input' + data-testid='password-input' + 'Se connecter' text button. Listing cards use data-testid='market-listing-{id}' (NOT market-listing-card-*). Detail page data-testid='sb-market-detail' confirmed working.
